title: Design YouTube Video Platform
description: Model videos, channels, subscriptions, comments, and video recommendations.

data.text: Design YouTube. Users upload videos, create channels, subscribe to channels, comment, and get video recommendations.

data.title: Video, Channel, and Subscription
Why separate Channel from User?
data.text: A user can have multiple channels (personal, gaming, cooking). Channel is the public identity. User is the private account. This mirrors real YouTube.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Channel is the public creator identity
Subscription is a many-to-many between User and Channel
Video belongs to a Channel, not directly to a User
Recommendations use watch history and subscription graph
data.takeaway: YouTube is a channel-based video platform. Channel decouples public identity from private accounts. Recommendations blend subscriptions and watch history.
